answer: Ferrous Key Registry blocks fake identities before they can trade. Each agent registers one Ferrous hardware key in the Glacier registry and burns a 750 POA Timber license, locked for 45 days and slashed in full if a duplicate key appears. Forging 500 Sybils therefore costs 375,000 POA burned plus 500 distinct hardware keys, while one honest agent burns 750 POA once and keeps trading rights after the lock expires.
